case.summary: Analyst review of transaction 3478561 ($74.96, November 22, 2016) identified a single mobile device profile (SM-G935F, Android 7.0, chrome 62.0) operating behind an anonymous proxy across dozens of unrelated customer cards. The device made 1-3 purchases per card ($35–$250 range) in August–September 2016 (24 cards) and November 14–22, 2016 (20+ cards), consistently marked as New. On card C13487-K1, two unauthorized purchases totaling $187.33 occurred on November 15 and 22; the cardholder denies both transactions. This undocumented coordinated fraud pattern indicates systematic account compromise or exploitation. The card is blocked, the case escalated, and 19 connected cards are under monitoring.

sar.narrative: Customer C13487, card C13487-K1, reported two unauthorized online purchases totaling $187.33 made from device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android. Transactions occurred on November 15, 2016 at 20:30 UTC ($112.37) and November 22, 2016 at 16:11 UTC ($74.96), both card-not-present online purchases in region 191.0. The cardholder denies knowledge of these purchases and continues to possess the physical card. Investigation determined the same device profile, marked as New on this account and operating behind an anonymous proxy, was used to make similar 1–3 purchases ($35–$250 amounts) on at least 19 other customer cards during November 14–22, 2016. Historical analysis revealed this identical device profile and proxy made similar purchases on 24 additional customer cards during August–September 2016, all previously confirmed as fraudulent. The pattern demonstrates coordinated activity across many unrelated accounts: single device, anonymous proxy, brief burst of 1–3 purchases per account, then movement to the next target. This undocumented pattern does not match the bank's known fraud categories but exhibits clear indicators of systematic abuse including volume across customers, device reuse, rapid account rotation, and cardholder denial. Card C13487-K1 has been blocked; the investigation has been escalated to an analyst for further review; and 19 connected cards sharing the device profile are under enhanced monitoring.
